instruction: Install and run collectd (system metrics collector)
output: apt install -y collectd && systemctl enable --now collectd

instruction: Configure collectd to send to a remote server
output:
echo -e 'LoadPlugin network
<Plugin network>
	Server "192.168.1.100" "25826"
</Plugin>' >> /etc/collectd/collectd.conf && systemctl restart collectd

instruction: Install and run telegraf for metrics collection
output: wget -qO- https://repos.influxdata.com/influxdata-archive_compat.key | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/influxdb.gpg && echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/influxdb.gpg] https://repos.influxdata.com/debian stable main' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/influxdata.list && apt update && apt install -y telegraf && systemctl enable --now telegraf
telegraf --test --config /etc/telegraf/telegraf.conf | head -30

instruction: Configure Telegraf to send to InfluxDB
output: echo -e '[[outputs.influxdb]]\n  urls = ["http://localhost:8086"]\n  database = "telegraf"' >> /etc/telegraf/telegraf.conf && systemctl restart telegraf
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8086/query --data-urlencode 'db=telegraf' --data-urlencode 'q=SELECT * FROM cpu LIMIT 5' | jq '.'
apt install -y chronograf && systemctl enable --now chronograf
apt install -y kapacitor && systemctl enable --now kapacitor

instruction: Create a Kapacitor alert for high CPU
output:
cat > cpu_alert.tick << 'EOF'
stream
    |from()
        .measurement('cpu')
    |alert()
        .crit(lambda: int("usage_idle") < 20)
        .log('/tmp/alerts.log')
EOF
kapacitor define cpu_alert -tick cpu_alert.tick && kapacitor enable cpu_alert
apt install -y check-mk-agent && systemctl enable --now checkmk-agent
apt install -y nagios4 nagios4-core && systemctl enable --now nagios4
